newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday as buying interest remained thin despite gains in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,400-05 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,410 rupiah. Crude palm oil was traded at 1,239.50 rupiah/kg at a tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Thursday.
"Increases in Malaysia in the afternoon boosted local sentiment, but buyers were not showing that much interest ahead of the weekend," one trader said.
The traders said export prices were better than local values, adding that this coupled with lower export taxes for April could see more players exporting their oil.
Traders said they expected palm olein prices to hover around current levels next week.

"Prices should be staying at around the present range next week because I don't see any significant improvement in demand," one trader said. "Some players are saying supply is beginning to get tight, but I think it's generally alright at the moment."
